ideas.title: Investigating Childcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the childcare fraud scandal in Minnesota, including the Trump administration's response and the impact on childcare providers and families.
questions: What is the extent of the childcare fraud in Minnesota?
How has the Trump administration responded to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable, making it a high-priority investigation.
